description: Accessibility improvements: keyboard-only navigation, high contrast mode, screen reader ARIA hints, reduced motion support, and color-blind friendly palettes. Critical for youth audience (ages 10-18) and inclusive design.
steps: Create packages/game-engine/src/accessibility/accessibilityDefinitions.ts with definitions for accessibility modes: HighContrastMode (standard, high, colorblind_deuteranopia, colorblind_protanopia), ReducedMotionMode (none, reduce, eliminate), and a set of ARIA live region announcement types (item_pickup, quest_update, npc_dialogue, system_message).

Create packages/game-engine/src/accessibility/accessibilityOps.ts with pure functions: getHighContrastPalette(mode) returning CSS custom properties map, shouldReduceMotion(mode) boolean, getAnnouncementText(type, params) returning i18n key strings for screen reader.
Create packages/game-engine/src/accessibility/index.ts exporting all definitions and ops.

Create packages/game-engine/src/components/AccessibilityComponent.ts with fields: highContrastMode, reducedMotionMode, keyboardNavigationEnabled (boolean), focusedPanelId (string|null), announcements (queue of {type, key, params} to read aloud), version number. Component type: 'accessibility'.

Create packages/game-engine/src/systems/AccessibilitySystem.ts that processes entities with 'accessibility' component. The system: clears stale announcements older than 3 seconds, and can enqueue announcements when it detects new inventory items or quest state changes by comparing component versions.

Add accessibility-related i18n keys to all 12 locale files in apps/web/src/i18n/messages/: settings.accessibility, settings.highContrast, settings.reducedMotion, settings.keyboardNav, a11y.itemPickup, a11y.questUpdate, a11y.announce.*, etc.

Create apps/web/src/stores/accessibilityStore.ts (Zustand) with state: highContrastMode, reducedMotionMode, keyboardNavigationEnabled, announcements[]. Reads prefers-reduced-motion and prefers-contrast media queries as defaults on init. Persists choices to localStorage.

Create apps/web/src/components/AccessibilitySettings.tsx panel section within SettingsPanel showing toggle for keyboard navigation, dropdown for contrast mode (standard/high/deuteranopia/protanopia), dropdown for motion (full/reduced/minimal). Uses i18n keys.

Create apps/web/src/components/AriaAnnouncer.tsx - an aria-live='polite' region that reads out announcements from the store. Also adds aria-labels to key HUD elements (hotbar slots, inventory items, status bars, clock).

Add ARIA attributes throughout existing UI components: role, aria-label, aria-describedby, tabIndex for keyboard focus management. Update GameUI.tsx, InventoryPanel.tsx, ShopPanel.tsx, QuestLog.tsx, SettingsPanel.tsx, DialoguePanel.tsx.
Add CSS custom properties for high-contrast and color-blind palettes in apps/web global styles or a dedicated accessibility.css that toggles based on a data attribute on the root element.

Add keyboard trap management: when a panel is open, Tab/Shift+Tab cycle through its interactive elements only (focus trap). Esc always closes the topmost panel. This extends the existing panelStack.ts logic.
Export new components and system from packages/game-engine/src/index.ts. Register the system in apps/web/src/game/createGameWorld.ts.
Write tests in packages/game-engine/src/__tests__/accessibility.test.ts covering: palette generation for each mode, announcement queueing and expiry, reduced motion decisions. At least 20 test cases.
Write tests in apps/web/src/__tests__/accessibility.test.tsx for the store (localStorage persistence, media query defaults) and the AriaAnnouncer rendering.
acceptance_criteria: pnpm build passes with new accessibility module compiled
pnpm test passes with at least 20 new accessibility-related test cases
pnpm lint passes with no new warnings
All 12 locale files have the new accessibility i18n keys
AccessibilityComponent is exported from game-engine index
